artifact.summary: Abstained: the abstract does not define the QPA unitary U (its form and theta dependence), the encoding of the length-5 binary input into the particle state, the number of evolution steps, the position-space dimension, or the GA-found boundary partition. Any circuit would rely on invented details, so no code was generated.

equation_mapping.explanation: The evolution |psi_t> = U^t |psi_0> is an assumed generic model. U is not specified, so it cannot be turned into a gate sequence without fabricating the operator.
The decision rule is a measurement-probability and classical post-processing step that depends on the unknown boundary partition. It is not part of a measurement-free unitary operation.
